answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. Each new agent vertex pays a one-time, non-refundable tax of 200 units before joining the trellis of verified peers. The tax is burned, not refunded, so 1,000 fakes cost 200,000 units upfront, while one honest agent pays only 200. Crossing a tundra allows no shortcut: each extra identity faces the same harsh cost. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards, so faking at scale loses money.
